title: Waterloo Greenway Discussion Takes Center Stage
summary:
*   The primary focus of the meeting is a discussion regarding the upcoming Waterloo Greenway Groundbreaking Ceremony.
*   City officials may be present to discuss the significant park project.
*   No official policy decisions or actions are scheduled to be taken at this meeting.
transcript:
